minTokens.description: clone window size in normalized tokens; lower = more sensitive

threshold.description: max allowed duplicated-lines percent across the scanned tree; 0 disables failing (report only)

ignore.description: globs relative to the scan root for framework-idiomatic declarative files (e.g. collections/**); their repetition is shape, not logic

includeTests.description: include *.test.*/*.spec.* files in the clone scan; catches copy-pasted test scaffolding, but table-driven tests and intentional fixture similarity add noise

maxFileLines.description: files over this many lines are flagged

maxFunctionLines.description: functions/methods over this many lines are flagged

maxClassMethods.description: classes with more public methods are flagged

ignorePaths.description: globs (scan-root- or repo-relative) for files exempt from size budgets
globs for files exempt from the docs gate and excluded from the component index

ignoreExports.description: export names that are framework configuration, not shared surface (Next.js segment config is auto-defaulted when next.config.* exists)

deny.description: dependency-direction rules: a file matching `from` importing a file matching `forbid` is a violation. Never baselined.
